title: Islam Must Come
body:
Dastur Ya Sayyidi, Ya Sultan, Ya Rijal Allah La ilaha illa Allah La ilaha illa Allah La ilaha illa Allah
Muhammadun Rasulullah, alihi salatullah wa salam. Assalamu alaykum Ya Rijalallah, Ya Ibadallahi
Salihin ammidduna bi madadikum, salamun alaykum. Assalamu alaykum Rijal Allah, assalamu
alaykum Ibadallhi mukhlisin.
Assalamu alaykum Ya mu'minin wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu. We are saying: Audhu Billahi
min as shaytan ar rajim Bismillah ar Rahman ar Rahim, to make our humble meeting a
protected meeting. And we are asking not to step through our humble meeting, we are
even not happy for shaytan or his dirty groups to come close because they are against
Haqq, against Truth, against Reality. Real Reality.
Ruh. Ruh that means giving everything life. Ruh, that giving every creature in existence
taking its power from that. Therefore we are asking. Sometimes these instruments some
shaytans playing on it, asking to enter and to make kharb, to destroy. Masha Allah, to
destroy real addressing from heavenly addressing, to make parasite. Parasite, you know?
What is it in English, say? Parasite. Yes, now shaytan standing up because it is looking
now that some waves or some bombarding just turned on its castles. Not yet that
bombarding began but it is such a declaration it is trying different directions. That is
heavenly artillery, like this trembling, tembling.
Therefore shaytan asking to take away every danger on itself and its followers. Just
beginning now from beginning of Rajab shahrullah, bombarding continuously. Beginning
artillery bombarding now on the fortress, beginning one or two. And shaytan, very
shaytan, very, we may say clever, doesn’t matter. He is knowing if from one center
beginning a bombarding that means tomorrow or next month or next year that

bombarding going to ya'ummul jihad, spread.
Shaytan is knowing this. He is saying that that Shaykh is remaining, only one whose
artillery is on us. But shaytan is understanding that that is a sign of the beginning of
general attack on shaytan and its false. I am informed that when they said to me
something, making through east and west some center. That is from shaytan, that means
it is understanding that behind this is a big bombarding coming, therefore it is thinking
that, “I may try to stop it and to keep my people behind through my fortress and we may
use our effort on those people that are preparing themselves for destroying our ways”.
I am happy. Last night I was sad but last night I have been granted that best khabar,
pleasure, good tidings then my heart getting in peace, no more like this. Heavenly good
tidings that reaching to our sultan coming, the news that shaytan and shaytanic
organisations through Islamic World more than western countries because shaytan
crowding its majority powers on Islamic world to make Islam down. Shaytan not taking
any care for western countries, saying “They are through my pockets. I just hunted them.
Christianity on my right hand, Judaism my left hand. All of them with me but danger
coming to me and my efforts from Islamic World, therefore I am crowding my majority
powers through Islamic World”.
And O Salafi ulamas, you must come with me, Azhar Sharif ulamas must come with me.
Libyan and Islamic world, all sincere ones, alims, scholars must come with me. You must
not leave me alone. If you are leaving me alone, doesn't matter because I am enough with
my weakness for a thousand shaytans. Allahu Akbar, our sword enough for millions
shaytans. They are not coming with me, Islamic scholars, ulamas, I don't care because
what I have been granted, heavenly sword is enough for every juhud. If they are not
coming and making a support for me doesn't matter but after destroying shaytanic
fortress and castles, my sword may work on their heads and I am nothing. I am zero.
Zero.
That is a heavenly caution. I am so weak but no one knows my spiritual power. I am now
nothing, so weak, but that belongs to my physical being. My spiritual being just dressed
with power for defeating. Deen ul Haqq Islam, must come! O our Lord, O our Lord, we're

asking to make an ant, warn all ants. I may be weakest one for warning through east and
west. And now shaytan is fearing that there must arise through Islamic world some
mukhlis, sincere, righteous people, standing up and asking “Where is real Islam? Where is
the Seal of Prophets mission?”
They are standing up and should ask and those who are against, through one night all of
them should be taken away because the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (sas) is
Nabi ins wal jinn, Rasul Thakhalayn. If my weakness not reaching to them there is Thakhalayn
ins wal jinn. One jinn is enough but they are not using those people, no. They have enough,
more than enough, if they should be, every munkar, deniers, they are dinosaurs. Deniers
are dinosaurs. Allah Almighty taking that handsome face and putting on them zulmat,
darkness and ugliness. And you may understand who is with shaytan and who is with the
Lord of Heavens.
Don't think that is an old person standing up and saying. I am weakest one but so many
powerful ones, Oh, endless. But we are only mukallaf, responsible, we have an identitiy to
be Muslims. Now heavenly announcement coming, reaching to people through the same,
weak center. I am ashaming to say that we are a center reaching to people, "O People,
get your taraf, side, to be with Prophets, the Seal of Prophets and one side to be with
shaytan.
Now, O Salafi ulamas I am asking a question to you. It is important that Allah Almighty
saying through Holy Quran Karim, Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Rahim
waimtazu alyawma ayyuha almujrimuna (36:59)
It is Holy Quran or I am saying this? Salafi ulamas saying, that that is an addressing to
people for the Day of Resurrection, Judgement Day, but Quran Karim's meanings,
oceans and we may now use this as an addressing first to Muslim World, because whole
Muslim world now are written under the title 'mujrimun'. Whole Islamic World, their
names written under the headline of: waimtazu alyawma ayyuha almujrimuna. Written their
name 'mujrimun' from every level of people, from number 1 up to zero. Yes, because no
territory, no malik, no president, no minister or anyone from Muslim World, are using
what Allah Almighty saying, astaidh Billah: waman lam yahkum bima anzala Allahu faulaika
humu alkafiroona (5:44) humu almunafiqun, humu alfasiqun.

Where are our heads that are leading Muslim ummah? Where are you? Not understanding
Arabic? Therefore every state on Earth that are saying 'We are Muslims', perhaps 45
Muslim states, their names under criminal ones, they are mujrimun. Allah never likes to be
cheated. No one can cheat Him. It is not enough to say 'We are Muslims'. Qul hatoo
burhnakum, bring your proof. Where is Holy Quran? You are running after democracy.
Democracy, the sign of kufr. You are asking from western people to bring to you modern
life. What is modern life? What is that? That is kufr. Rasulullah, peace be upon him was
advising his ummah to follow western countries? Therefore all states their names under
criminal, all of them mujrimun. They must look for some advocate.
Why not saying this, you Salafi ulamas? I am lying or saying truth? Why you are not
saying that that weak person is speaking truth? Why not saying! And those who are trying
to stop this broadcasting should be with shaytan. Taken away. O People, may Allah
forgive us. La ilaha illa Allah Sayyidina Muhammadun Rasulullah. Ya Rasulullah, everything that
your Lord ordering to you to reach to people from heavenly orders, you did it on best,
most perfect way but we have lost it. Shafa`at Ya Rasulullah. Your intercession we are
asking. Send us someone to correct our steps not to be written our names under the holy
verse: waimtazu alyawma ayyuha almujrimuna.
What is that? Every Muslim country is making football things. For what? What is that?
Even in Saudi Arabia, football? Egypt, football? Sham football, Iraq football, Yemen
football, Pakistan football, Turkey football. What is that football? May fall on their heads,
heavenly stones as reached to qawm Abraha. You are not reciting O Salafi ulamas. Astaidh
Billah: alam tara kayfa fa`ala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli (105:1) Not reciting? Allah Almighty
making Quran Karim storybook? Why not thinking on it? Astaidh Billah: alam tara kayfa
fa`ala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli.
That surah, we are in it now. That is giving a panorama from our life, like armies of
Abraha. People now, O Salafi ulamas, are like Abraha and his armies. Alam yaj`al
kaydahum fee tadleelin (105:2) Waarsala `alayhim tayran ababeela (105:3) Quran Karim
samit/silent or al ad-dawam, speaking continuously? Finished at the time of Prophet or that
continues? What is mentioned in Holy Quran, going on or not? I am asking you. Why

you are not warning your nation?
Muslims, your people, inhabitants, your nation is under your control. Why you are not
warning them that Allah Almighty not saying stories? No. When He is saying something,
showing that it may be for you also. If you are getting out that bombarding from heavens
is ready to fall on you, to bombard you. Why you are not saying? You are learning to say
only bid`a, kufr, haram, shirk, beyond this people doing hundreds of dirty things, dirty ideas.
Why you are not controlling them? And rushing on Muslims, 'don't do this, don't do that'.
Why you are not saying to people ‘don't smoke’ and through the mamlakat why you are
not saying, dukhan haram? Why you are not saying?
You are knowing only to say, "don't turn your face to maqam Rasul" (sas), or "don't say
assalatu wa-salamu alayk Ya Rasulullah". What is that? Hundreds of points for which you
have responsibility you are not doing therefore, look your faces through mirror and fear
from Allah not to be changed your faces as Allah changed Banu Israel's faces to monkeys
and pigs. Beware. Keep your limit. Don't try to jump on it, no. You have a big area to
work on if you are ulamas. Ulamas must be brave ones, jari, shuj`a. Courageous, yes. Wa
min Allahi tawfiq. May Allah forgive us.
Fatiha.
We must do a little bit,
dum dum dum dum,
dum dum dum dum,
dum dum dum dum,
dum dum dum dum,
we are going victorious as long as we are Muslims under the holy flag of the Seal of
Prophets sallallahu alayhi wa sallam.
Fatiha
